newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe up on debt-deal speculation.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe up on debt-deal speculation.

text.p: Polish debt-ridden construction company Espebepe SA surged 10 percent to 4.95 zlotys on speculation that the firm might win a debt write-off deal, traders said.
Espebepe did not trade after price fixing due to excess demand.

"It's pure speculation of well-trained speculators, the company's capitalisation is now of about 10 million zlotys so it's not difficult to cause such rise, but the possibility of winning the deal is as likely as bankruptcy," one trader said.
On Monday Espebepe's creditors' second meeting was postponed till May 16. Traders said the stock was prone to sharp price movements before the next creditors meeting.
